query_text: Why do men have larger Adam's apples?

messages.content: Why do men have larger Adam's apples?

message.content:
Men usually have larger Adam’s apples because **testosterone-driven puberty changes** make the **larynx (voice box) grow more in males**, which also makes the **thyroid cartilage** at the front of the throat stick out more.[1][3][8]

A few key points:

- **Everyone has an Adam’s apple**; it is the **laryngeal prominence** of the thyroid cartilage.[1][8]
- Before puberty, boys and girls have similar larynx sizes.[1][6]
- During male puberty, **testosterone** causes the larynx and vocal cords to grow more, so the front of the throat becomes more prominent.[1][3][6]
- The larger larynx is also linked to the **deeper male voice**.[3][6][8]
- The size varies a lot between individuals, so some women can have a visible Adam’s apple too.[1][6][8]

If you want, I can also explain **why it’s called the Adam’s apple** or **how it relates to voice deepening**.
